title: Live Observation Tool-Use Eval (CoT-Only vs. Caelus MCP Tools)
hypothesis: Equipping a live LLM/VLM with local in-process Caelus observation tools (verify_observation, chronolocate, geolocate, scene_geometry backed by packages/caelus/dist/) on the 30-task EXP-003/vlm_eval_pack.jsonl raises spacetime spoof-detection F1 from near-chance (~0.55-0.65) to >= 0.88, raises counterfactual single-axis diagnostic recovery, chronolocation (<= 20 min), and geolocation (<= 350 km) accuracy decisively over chain-of-thought alone, and executes local tools in milliseconds (< 2 ms forward authentic verification, < 10 ms median across all tools including counterfactual forensics and global grids).
null_baseline: Arm1-CoT-NoTools: the exact same live model(s) evaluating identical scene descriptions, claimed spacetime context, and visual shadow/twilight/lunar measurements via chain-of-thought reasoning only with zero external tools.
success_bar: Arm2-Caelus-MCP-Tools achieves spoof-detection F1 >= 0.88 (beating Arm1-CoT-NoTools by >= 0.20 F1), achieves >= 80% pass rate on chronolocation (<= 20 min) and geolocation (<= 350 km) where Arm1-CoT-NoTools stays below 35%, improves overall 30-task pass rate by >= 40 percentage points, and executes local tools at < 10 ms median latency (< 2 ms warm forward authentic verify_observation).
kill_criterion: If Arm2-Caelus-MCP-Tools achieves spoof-detection F1 < 0.80, fails to beat Arm1-CoT-NoTools by >= 0.15 F1 or >= 25 percentage points overall task pass rate, or if tool-calling schema failures degrade accuracy below baseline on > 25% of tasks.
